pr_title: feat(android): Adding custom port parameter to connect to different adb server port
pr_body:
feat(android-custom-options): Adding a custom port parameter to connect to the different adb server port. 

Adding option to connect to custom ADB server port other than 5037. 
Fixes #11464
pr_comments: @mxschmitt Have updated the tests. Let me know if any more modifications are required.

> One high level comment is that it should be host:port ?

Clarified offline, we wait for user feedback for now.
